fields.name: VisualIndex
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1EA6210 (from AiPathVisualSystem step bg3.exe+0x1EA4E00) writes -1. The drawing step bg3.exe+0x1EA51E0 of ecl::AiPathVisualSystem reads it as *(int*)(array + i*4): when -1 it allocates a 0x140-byte path render object, puts it into the system's pool (pointer array at system+0x100, occupancy bitset at system+0xF0) and stores the slot index back into the component; otherwise it uses pool[index]. The per-frame update bg3.exe+0x1EA4C30 frees pool slots of removed entities. So: slot of this entity's path visual in the system pool, -1 = none. Live -1.

second_pass: Settled from ecl::AiPathVisualSystem's drawing step bg3.exe+0x1EA51E0, which reads the int as a pool slot (-1 = allocate a new path visual) and writes the new slot index back.
